name: Classic rock covers for an office party: Drive, Tony Medina
description: Here's Tony Medina at an office party, playing Drive, the Cars song. He can play solo, or bring a band of up to four if you want people dancing.
more: If your venue is on the small side, Tony's trio of guitar, bass and drums can still get people dancing. The four-piece adds a second guitar or keys. It's his full dance band, and we'd suggest it for office parties and milestone birthdays.
